slides.narration: Chapter 12: Four Dimensions. Why does space have three dimensions and time have one? Because the tower at stage six has eight positions, three of which are bridges — and the ceiling of eight divided by two is four.

The eight positions split into three bridge positions — which become the three directions of space — and the Higgs mechanism, which creates the time direction. Four dimensions total: three of space, one of time. Not assumed — derived from the tower's structure.
